content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-p06-dhitq_kr/report.rdl

Add a hidden Integer parameter TopN with a default of 10.

I added the hidden Integer parameter `TopN` with a default value of 10. The report validates with no errors.

The validation warnings are about things I didn't change: two unused data sources (`LegacySQL`, `ScratchPowerQuery`), `DateFrom` and `DateTo` being typed as String, and an orphan `Utilization` field in `DataSet1`.

`TopN` isn't referenced by any dataset or expression yet. If you want it to limit results, I can wire it into a dataset query as a `@TopN` parameter.
